title: It’s Not That Amazing.
paragraphs: “He’s the type to use such underhanded tactics without hesitation. Without a doubt… he crushed Rat’s research and drove her out.”
“What? Are you saying that something like that almost happened to me?”
The doctor frowned and spoke with displeasure. Well, it’s about an unfortunate future for herself. It’s a reaction similar to what Ren and Itsuki had last time.
“I can’t say it’s impossible, but isn’t that a bit of a leap?”
That being said, perhaps it’s because of her scholarly nature. She looks like she thinks it’s a possibility.
“It’s just a possibility… But if Rat was driven out by some means, then it’s possible.”
“I don’t want to believe in a future where that child didn’t compete through research but instead eliminated my department.”
“Since it’s only a possibility caused by us coming to Faubrey, I don’t think you need to worry about it too much…”

The doctor looks like she doesn’t really want to believe what Father is saying. However, facts are facts. Considering Takt and his ties to that pig, it’s easy to envision such a future. I believe the doctor is capable of understanding that much.
“For now, isn’t it fine that Rat can continue her research here?”
“Yes… but I would have liked to compete with that child a little longer.”

The doctor spoke with a sigh. She is lamenting the loss of her rival. I understand that feeling, just a little. If Filo-tan’s rival, Rival, were to retire without a fight, it would feel anticlimactic.
“She’s a bit unhinged sometimes, but she seems to be quite dedicated to her research.”
“She’s reasonably competent.”
Father and I analyze the doctor in hushed tones. I dislike her for giving injections to Filo-tan, but I respect her dedication to research.
“Rat wanted to compete? Even though that child could have been her own downfall?”
“Hm? Yes, to be honest, she was someone I wanted to improve myself against through healthy competition.”
“Takt and his group seemed to want to nip any threats in the bud, though?”
Father’s words made the doctor fold her arms before answering.
“What’s the point of kicking someone down?”
“Didn’t it benefit them?”
“…That may be true. But even if that story is true, the fact that my department was eliminated doesn’t mean that child was amazing.”
“Well… that’s true.”
Exactly. Even if you eliminate your rivals, it means nothing if your own research isn’t recognized.
“The same goes for me. Just because the competition is gone doesn’t mean my research is complete or acknowledged. I wouldn’t be satisfied with that.”
“Wow… somehow, that sounds really dignified.”
“It sounds like a constant battle with oneself.”

As expected of Filo-tan’s doctor. I feel like I’ve caught a glimpse of the strength that comes with being her physician. I can understand why the Father in the first world had the doctor living in his territory.
“By the way, what’s this about the Four Holy Heroes and the Whip Hero?”
“Ah… well, I guess there’s no need to hide it. I’ve been keeping the information sealed, though…”
“Speaking about it might cause trouble, is that okay?”
Currently, while we’re in the process of eliminating Takt’s remaining forces, much of the information is being kept under wraps within Faubrey.
“If my department is involved, wouldn’t it be better if I knew?”
“That’s true… Okay. This ties into the fact that Motoyasu came from the future, but… Takt, the Whip Hero, was—”

We explained that Takt was a criminal who killed the Seven Star Heroes and stole their weapons, and that we were in the process of eliminating his affiliates. The Homunculus Research Institute was one of those affiliates, and since there was a possibility of some form of resistance, we warned her to be cautious.
“So that’s why all those corrupt institutions are being taken down…”
“Yes. We’re making sure that the Takt faction doesn’t use their power to cause chaos.”

“Still… future information aside, possessing three of the Seven Star Weapons… Yeah, that’s definitely something worth eliminating. And when the voices of the Four Holy Heroes are involved, there’s no room for defiance.”
“Please do your best to keep this confidential.”
The doctor waved her hand lightly in response.
“If I talked about it, I might get wiped out myself. No way I’m doing that.”
“Well, since we’re acquaintances now, Rat, is there anything Motoyasu can do to help with your research?”
“Indeed. How about bringing some Bio Plant seeds?”
That was the research we did during the first loop. The doctor had been enthusiastically conducting research back then. I briefly explained the concept of the Bio Plants.
“A plant with such miraculous reproductive capabilities? If it exists, I’d love to see it.”
“I have it, of course. Father and I created various subspecies in the first world.”
“That sounds good, but… I’d really like to closely observe how monsters exhibit abnormal growth when nurtured by a Hero.”
“It might be a good time to think about strengthening our forces to prepare for the next Wave.”
“Please also conduct a health check-up for Filo-tan.”
“I’m an alchemist, not a monster doctor, you know? Well… fine.”
The doctor sighed.
With her level of skill, what is there to be dissatisfied about?
“Shall I fetch the seeds using the portal today?”
“Yes, that would be good. If Rat examines them, the research will advance even further.”
“Well, I guess that’s the end of the conversation then.”
The doctor finished the conversation and casually returned to me and the Father, grabbing Sakura-chan and Kou by the scruff of their necks.
What is she doing?
“Ah, oh no! Kou is scared!”
“W-Wah! Naofumi, help me!”
“Both of you, bear with it. Yuki-chan went through this too.”
“That’s right. I won’t be the only one to endure this.”
“Nooo!”

Sakura-chan and Kou’s screams echoed, but the health checkup was completed without any issues. That same day, I went to get the Bio Plant seeds and handed them to the doctor. She was skeptical at first, but when the seeds sprouted immediately after planting, her expression changed. As expected of a researcher.
“They would normally turn into monsters and go berserk. So, I made some adjustments to prevent that.”
With the mutation level reduced, these seeds are relatively safe now. First, we need to increase the seed supply so the Father and the others can handle them as well.
“This looks like it’ll be worth researching.”
The doctor started researching the Bio Plants with enthusiasm. She began by recording her observations and analyzing the leaves, stems, and fruits.
“When the seeds increase, call the Four Holy Heroes, and I’ll modify them as requested anytime.”

With Bio Plant materials, it’s possible to obtain the necessary skills for modifications. The Father and the others, who have been improving their literacy, are steadily learning magic as well. As a result, they’ll eventually be able to modify the plants just like I can. As long as someone modifies the settings of the Bio Plants according to the doctor’s requests, it’ll be fine.
“Yeah, yeah. I got it.”

The doctor seems completely absorbed in the Bio Plants. If she had the right equipment, she might even be able to do what the Father and I did together in the first world. I’m looking forward to seeing the results. And with that, my work for the day was done. Well, in the end, I spent about a week fetching the portal locations for everything. And now, the Waves are approaching. In a few days, we’ll be facing a Wave in a certain country. Today, I have an audience scheduled with the Pig King after a long time, so I’ll be going to meet him.
“Motoyasu, do you know where the Wave will occur?”
“Not at all. This is my first Wave.”
“So, it’s going to be a live test, huh?”
“I think we’ll manage somehow, but let’s not let our guard down.”
We waited in the reception room until the Pig King was ready. After a while, it seemed he had awakened, and we were summoned.
“Buhuhuhu… Heroes, it has been a while.”
“It’s been about a week.”
“So, how’s it going lately?”
“We’ll be participating in the upcoming Wave soon. We’ve managed to establish a network that allows us to participate in Waves all over the world.”
The Father showed him a map and explained the situation.
Have we ever been able to prepare for the Waves this efficiently in any world other than the first one?
“That is most reassuring. But I must relay some troubling news to you, brave heroes.”
“W-What is it?”
“Is there some kind of problem?”
Itsuki and Ren asked the Pig King. The Father, perhaps having some idea, gently patted Ren and Itsuki on the shoulders.
“What is it, Naofumi?”
“I think I figured it out too. Ren, you’ve got a hunch, don’t you?”
“…Yeah, it means it’s come around to us too.”
So, that’s how it is. I pretended to be in the know.
“W-What’s going on?”

“Listen, Itsuki. In Faubrey, ever since the incident with Takt, there’s been a worldwide order to summon all the Seven Star Heroes. They’re worried that the Seven Star Weapons might have fallen into the hands of someone like Takt.”
